name: Hollow Markets
description: Bazaars carved inside hollowed asteroids, lit by sodium lamps and stacked with stalls and workshops.
role: The trade floor of the belt, where anything can be bought, sold or fenced.
ambience: Crowded, loud and warm, with haggling, welding sparks and echoing tunnels.
paletteDirection: Rust reds, sodium amber lamps, Atlas yellow cloth and dark rock.
